## Cleaning 2024 Opihi Data - Mei

```{r}
#load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(lubridate)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
#import opihi 2024 quadrat and metadata data, master file 
metadata_2024 <- read.csv(here("Mei","Data","opihi_2024_metadata.csv"))
quadrat_2024 <- read.csv(here("Mei","Data","opihi_2024_quadrat.csv"))
master <- read.csv(here("Mei","Data","mei_master.csv"))
```

### Cleaning data

```{r}
#before joining metadata to survey data, have to clean data so everything matches
quadrat_2024 <- quadrat_2024 |> 
  mutate(
    Date=mdy(Date), 
    Location=recode(Location, "ʻEwa"="Ewa", "`Ewa"="Ewa", "Leʻahi"="Leahi", "Lēʻahi"="Leahi", "Mamala Bay"="Mamala")) #removed Hawaiian diacriticals (for now, will re-edit to correct Hawaiian names for figures, etc) 
  
  

#clean metadata
metadata_2024 <- metadata_2024 |> 
  mutate(
    Date=mdy(Date),
    Location=recode(Location, "ʻEwa"="Ewa", "`Ewa"="Ewa", "Le'ahi"="Leahi", "Lē'ahi"="Leahi", "Mamala Bay"="Mamala", "Ewa Beach"="Ewa", "Kalealoa"="Kalaeloa"))
  
```

### Using Gemini for code

```{r}
#I used Google Gemini to generate code to help join my metadata and quadrat datasets together. I did not provide any of the actual data to Gemini, only the column names shared by both datasets
opihi_2024 <- left_join(quadrat_2024, metadata_2024, by = c("Date", "Location")) |>
  clean_names() |> 
  rename(
    transect_number = x_t
  ) |> 
  write.csv(here("Mei","Data","opihi_2024.csv"))
```

### Cleaning Opihi 2020 data with Gemini

I used Gemini to clean the OPIHI 2020 data - specifically, I asked it to combine all the data in the csv file into one clean dataset with all the same column names, while retaining all the different species counts that had occurred throughout the multiple field trips. Prior to uploading a csv file to Gemini, I redacted all the school names and coded them by number instead.

```{r}
#this whole chunk is ai-generated code

# 1. Read the raw unheadered CSV file
raw_data <- read_csv("Data/opihi_2020_ai.csv", col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE)

# 2. Identify the starting column index for each survey block
# (Blocks begin where row 1 contains "Date" or row 8 contains "Location")
block_start_cols <- which(
  raw_data[1, ] == "Date" | raw_data[8, ] == "Location"
)

# Define column boundaries for each survey block
num_cols <- ncol(raw_data)
block_ranges <- map2(
  block_start_cols,
  c(block_start_cols[-1] - 1, num_cols),
  ~ c(.x, .y)
)

# 3. Function to parse an individual survey block
parse_survey_block <- function(start_col, end_col) {
  meta_label_col <- start_col
  meta_val_col   <- start_col + 1
  
  # Extract metadata values (rows 1 to 11)
  meta_keys <- raw_data[1:11, meta_label_col][[1]] %>% str_trim()
  meta_vals <- raw_data[1:11, meta_val_col][[1]]
  
  meta_df <- tibble(key = meta_keys, val = meta_vals) %>%
    filter(!is.na(key), key != "") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = key, values_from = val)
  
  # Ensure standard metadata names are present
  standard_meta <- c(
    "Date", "Start Time", "Stop Time", "Number of Transect Lines",
    "Length of Transect Lines", "Point Spacing", "Number of Quadrats per transect",
    "Location", "latitude", "longitude", "School"
  )
  for (m in standard_meta) {
    if (!m %in% names(meta_df)) meta_df[[m]] <- NA_character_
  }
  
  # Find row where "Organisms" header is located (rows 12-20)
  org_row_idx <- which(raw_data[12:20, meta_label_col][[1]] == "Organisms") + 11
  if (length(org_row_idx) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Extract quadrat sample header names (e.g. transect-1 quadrat-1 at point 0.00)
  quadrat_cols <- meta_val_col:end_col
  quadrat_names <- raw_data[org_row_idx, quadrat_cols] %>% unlist() %>% as.character() %>% str_trim()
  
  valid_quad_indices <- which(!is.na(quadrat_names) & quadrat_names != "")
  if (length(valid_quad_indices) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  quadrat_cols <- quadrat_cols[valid_quad_indices]
  quadrat_names <- quadrat_names[valid_quad_indices]
  
  # Extract species count rows
  species_rows <- (org_row_idx + 1):nrow(raw_data)
  species_names <- raw_data[species_rows, meta_label_col][[1]] %>% as.character() %>% str_trim()
  
  valid_spec_indices <- which(!is.na(species_names) & species_names != "")
  if (length(valid_spec_indices) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  species_rows <- species_rows[valid_spec_indices]
  species_names <- species_names[valid_spec_indices]
  
  # Build count matrix for this block
  counts_mat <- raw_data[species_rows, quadrat_cols]
  colnames(counts_mat) <- quadrat_names
  counts_mat$Organism <- species_names
  
  # Reshape to long format (quadrat sample x organism count)
  long_counts <- counts_mat %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -Organism, 
      names_to = "Quadrat_Sample", 
      values_to = "Count"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Count = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Count)), Count = ifelse(is.na(Count), 0, Count)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Organism, values_from = Count, values_fn = max, values_fill = 0)
  
  # Combine metadata with organism counts
  bind_cols(meta_df, long_counts)
}

# 4. Process all blocks and combine into one spreadsheet
combined_dataset <- map_dfr(block_ranges, ~ parse_survey_block(.x[1], .x[2]))

# 5. Fill missing values (NAs) in species count columns with 0
metadata_cols <- c(
  "Date", "Start Time", "Stop Time", "Number of Transect Lines",
  "Length of Transect Lines", "Point Spacing", "Number of Quadrats per transect",
  "Location", "latitude", "longitude", "School", "Quadrat_Sample"
)

species_cols <- setdiff(names(combined_dataset), metadata_cols)

combined_dataset <- combined_dataset %>%
  select(all_of(metadata_cols), sort(species_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(species_cols), ~ replace_na(as.numeric(.), 0)))

# 6. Save consolidated CSV
write_csv(combined_dataset, "opihi_2020_combined.csv")

# View structure
glimpse(combined_dataset)
```

After looking through the code it generated and the outputs, it added some unnecessary columns and some of the numbers were wrong because I think it got confused with some of the totals columns. I tried again by asking Gemini to ignore everything under Totals:

```{r}
#ai-generated code

# 1. Read raw CSV
#raw_data <- read_csv("opihi_2020_ai.csv", col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE)

# 2. Identify start column of each survey block
block_start_cols <- which(
  raw_data[1, ] == "Date" | raw_data[8, ] == "Location"
)

num_cols <- ncol(raw_data)
block_ranges <- map2(
  block_start_cols,
  c(block_start_cols[-1] - 1, num_cols),
  ~ c(.x, .y)
)

# 3. Block parser function (stops before 'TOTALS:')
parse_survey_block <- function(start_col, end_col) {
  meta_label_col <- start_col
  meta_val_col   <- start_col + 1
  
  # Extract metadata values (rows 1 to 11)
  meta_keys <- raw_data[1:11, meta_label_col][[1]] %>% str_trim()
  meta_vals <- raw_data[1:11, meta_val_col][[1]]
  
  meta_df <- tibble(key = meta_keys, val = meta_vals) %>%
    filter(!is.na(key), key != "") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = key, values_from = val)
  
  standard_meta <- c(
    "Date", "Start Time", "Stop Time", "Number of Transect Lines",
    "Length of Transect Lines", "Point Spacing", "Number of Quadrats per transect",
    "Location", "latitude", "longitude", "School"
  )
  for (m in standard_meta) {
    if (!m %in% names(meta_df)) meta_df[[m]] <- NA_character_
  }
  
  # Locate 'Organisms' row header
  org_row_idx <- which(raw_data[12:20, meta_label_col][[1]] == "Organisms") + 11
  if (length(org_row_idx) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Locate 'TOTALS:' row index to ignore everything below it
  all_col_labels <- raw_data[(org_row_idx + 1):nrow(raw_data), meta_label_col][[1]] %>% as.character()
  totals_rel_idx <- which(str_detect(str_to_upper(all_col_labels), "TOTALS"))
  
  if (length(totals_rel_idx) > 0) {
    max_species_row <- org_row_idx + totals_rel_idx[1] - 1
  } else {
    max_species_row <- nrow(raw_data)
  }
  
  # Extract quadrat sample header names
  quadrat_cols <- meta_val_col:end_col
  quadrat_names <- raw_data[org_row_idx, quadrat_cols] %>% unlist() %>% as.character() %>% str_trim()
  
  valid_quad_indices <- which(!is.na(quadrat_names) & quadrat_names != "")
  if (length(valid_quad_indices) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  quadrat_cols <- quadrat_cols[valid_quad_indices]
  quadrat_names <- quadrat_names[valid_quad_indices]
  
  # Extract raw individual quadrat species rows (stopping before TOTALS:)
  species_rows <- (org_row_idx + 1):max_species_row
  species_names <- raw_data[species_rows, meta_label_col][[1]] %>% as.character() %>% str_trim()
  
  valid_spec_indices <- which(!is.na(species_names) & species_names != "" & !str_detect(str_to_upper(species_names), "TOTALS"))
  if (length(valid_spec_indices) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  species_rows <- species_rows[valid_spec_indices]
  species_names <- species_names[valid_spec_indices]
  
  # Build count matrix for individual quadrats
  counts_mat <- raw_data[species_rows, quadrat_cols]
  colnames(counts_mat) <- quadrat_names
  counts_mat$Organism <- species_names
  
  # Reshape to wide quadrat table
  long_counts <- counts_mat %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -Organism, 
      names_to = "Quadrat_Sample", 
      values_to = "Count"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Count = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Count)), Count = ifelse(is.na(Count), 0, Count)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Organism, values_from = Count, values_fn = max, values_fill = 0)
  
  bind_cols(meta_df, long_counts)
}

# 4. Process blocks into a single clean dataset
combined_dataset <- map_dfr(block_ranges, ~ parse_survey_block(.x[1], .x[2]))

# 5. Fill missing values across species columns with 0
metadata_cols <- c(
  "Date", "Start Time", "Stop Time", "Number of Transect Lines",
  "Length of Transect Lines", "Point Spacing", "Number of Quadrats per transect",
  "Location", "latitude", "longitude", "School", "Quadrat_Sample"
)

species_cols <- setdiff(names(combined_dataset), metadata_cols)

combined_dataset <- combined_dataset %>%
  select(all_of(metadata_cols), sort(species_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(species_cols), ~ replace_na(as.numeric(.), 0)))

# 6. Save final dataset
write_csv(combined_dataset, "opihi_2020_combined_no_totals.csv")
```

It looks better now! Finally, I realized there was some unknown data at the very end of the sheet that has no associated metadata with it at all - I asked gemini to ignore that data when combining everything together. I also asked it to delete the columns M-S that it had added when cleaning the sheet.

```{r}

# 1. Read raw CSV
#raw_data <- read_csv("opihi_2020_ai.csv", col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE)

# 2. Limit raw dataset columns up to column FN (Column 170 in R)
max_col_fn <- min(ncol(raw_data), 170)
raw_data <- raw_data[, 1:max_col_fn]

# 3. Identify start column of each survey block within the raw data
block_start_cols <- which(
  raw_data[1, ] == "Date" | raw_data[8, ] == "Location"
)

num_cols <- ncol(raw_data)
block_ranges <- map2(
  block_start_cols,
  c(block_start_cols[-1] - 1, num_cols),
  ~ c(.x, .y)
)

# 4. Block parser function (stops before 'TOTALS:')
parse_survey_block <- function(start_col, end_col) {
  meta_label_col <- start_col
  meta_val_col   <- start_col + 1
  
  # Extract metadata values (rows 1 to 11)
  meta_keys <- raw_data[1:11, meta_label_col][[1]] %>% str_trim()
  meta_vals <- raw_data[1:11, meta_val_col][[1]]
  
  meta_df <- tibble(key = meta_keys, val = meta_vals) %>%
    filter(!is.na(key), key != "") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = key, values_from = val)
  
  standard_meta <- c(
    "Date", "Start Time", "Stop Time", "Number of Transect Lines",
    "Length of Transect Lines", "Point Spacing", "Number of Quadrats per transect",
    "Location", "latitude", "longitude", "School"
  )
  for (m in standard_meta) {
    if (!m %in% names(meta_df)) meta_df[[m]] <- NA_character_
  }
  
  # Locate 'Organisms' row header
  org_row_idx <- which(raw_data[12:20, meta_label_col][[1]] == "Organisms") + 11
  if (length(org_row_idx) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Locate 'TOTALS:' row index to ignore everything below it
  all_col_labels <- raw_data[(org_row_idx + 1):nrow(raw_data), meta_label_col][[1]] %>% as.character()
  totals_rel_idx <- which(str_detect(str_to_upper(all_col_labels), "TOTALS"))
  
  if (length(totals_rel_idx) > 0) {
    max_species_row <- org_row_idx + totals_rel_idx[1] - 1
  } else {
    max_species_row <- nrow(raw_data)
  }
  
  # Extract quadrat sample header names
  quadrat_cols <- meta_val_col:end_col
  quadrat_names <- raw_data[org_row_idx, quadrat_cols] %>% unlist() %>% as.character() %>% str_trim()
  
  valid_quad_indices <- which(!is.na(quadrat_names) & quadrat_names != "")
  if (length(valid_quad_indices) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  quadrat_cols <- quadrat_cols[valid_quad_indices]
  quadrat_names <- quadrat_names[valid_quad_indices]
  
  # Extract individual quadrat species rows (stopping before TOTALS:)
  species_rows <- (org_row_idx + 1):max_species_row
  species_names <- raw_data[species_rows, meta_label_col][[1]] %>% as.character() %>% str_trim()
  
  valid_spec_indices <- which(!is.na(species_names) & species_names != "" & !str_detect(str_to_upper(species_names), "TOTALS"))
  if (length(valid_spec_indices) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  species_rows <- species_rows[valid_spec_indices]
  species_names <- species_names[valid_spec_indices]
  
  # Build count matrix for individual quadrats
  counts_mat <- raw_data[species_rows, quadrat_cols]
  colnames(counts_mat) <- quadrat_names
  counts_mat$Organism <- species_names
  
  # Reshape to wide quadrat table
  long_counts <- counts_mat %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -Organism, 
      names_to = "Quadrat_Sample", 
      values_to = "Count"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Count = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Count)), Count = ifelse(is.na(Count), 0, Count)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Organism, values_from = Count, values_fn = max, values_fill = 0)
  
  bind_cols(meta_df, long_counts)
}

# 5. Process blocks into a single clean dataset
combined_dataset <- map_dfr(block_ranges, ~ parse_survey_block(.x[1], .x[2]))

# 6. Organize metadata and species columns, filling NAs with 0
metadata_cols <- c(
  "Date", "Start Time", "Stop Time", "Number of Transect Lines",
  "Length of Transect Lines", "Point Spacing", "Number of Quadrats per transect",
  "Location", "latitude", "longitude", "School", "Quadrat_Sample"
)

species_cols <- setdiff(names(combined_dataset), metadata_cols)

combined_dataset <- combined_dataset %>%
  select(all_of(metadata_cols), sort(species_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(species_cols), ~ replace_na(as.numeric(.), 0)))

# 7. REMOVE COLUMNS M THROUGH S (Columns 13:19) FROM THE FINAL COMBINED DATASET
# (Columns 1 to 12 are metadata + Quadrat_Sample; columns 13 to 19 are species columns M:S)
combined_dataset <- combined_dataset %>%
  select(-c(13:19))

# 8. Save final dataset
write_csv(combined_dataset, "opihi_2020_combined_final.csv")
```

With that, OPIHI 2020 looks cleaner and easier to join with the rest of the years and all the data looks correct to me.

### Cleaning OPIHI 2019 data with Gemini

Once again, I redacted all school names and coded them with numbers instead. I will put the school names back at the end when I am working in R myself. With the redacted data sheet, I asked Gemini to once again clean all the separate field trip entries into one clean datasheet with an R script. I asked it to ignore all data after row 54, which is when there are some rows for totals per species and not raw data itself.

Turns out I forgot to redact one of the schools :( changed that after I noticed it!

```{r}
#ai-generated code

# 1. Read the raw 2019 CSV dataset
raw_data <- read_csv("Data/opihi_2019_ai.csv", col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE)

# 2. Identify all survey block starting column indices (where row 1 == "Date")
block_start_cols <- which(raw_data[1, ] == "Date")

num_cols <- ncol(raw_data)
block_ranges <- map2(
  block_start_cols,
  c(block_start_cols[-1] - 1, num_cols),
  ~ c(.x, .y)
)

# 3. Block parser function that strictly caps row reading at row 54
parse_survey_block_2019 <- function(start_col, end_col) {
  meta_label_col <- start_col
  meta_val_col   <- start_col + 1
  
  # --- Extract Metadata (Rows 1 to 11) ---
  # Handle cases where Location key/val might be in adjacent columns
  meta_df <- tibble(
    key = raw_data[1:11, meta_label_col][[1]] %>% as.character() %>% str_trim(),
    val = raw_data[1:11, meta_val_col][[1]]
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(key), key != "", key != "NA") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = key, values_from = val, values_fn = first)
  
  # Check if location is recorded in nearby cell if omitted in key column
  if (!"Location" %in% names(meta_df) || is.na(meta_df$Location)) {
    loc_val <- raw_data[8, meta_val_col + 1][[1]]
    if (!is.na(loc_val) && str_trim(loc_val) != "") {
      meta_df$Location <- as.character(loc_val)
    }
  }
  
  standard_meta <- c(
    "Date", "Start Time", "Stop Time", "Number of Transect Lines",
    "Length of Transect Lines", "Point Spacing", "Number of Quadrats per transect",
    "Location", "latitude", "longitude", "School"
  )
  for (m in standard_meta) {
    if (!m %in% names(meta_df)) meta_df[[m]] <- NA_character_
  }
  
  # Locate 'Organisms' header row (typically row 13)
  org_row_idx <- which(raw_data[12:20, meta_label_col][[1]] == "Organisms") + 11
  if (length(org_row_idx) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # --- Cap reading strictly to Row 54 ---
  max_row_limit <- min(nrow(raw_data), 54)
  
  # Extract quadrat header names (e.g. T-1 Q-1 at point 0.00)
  quadrat_cols <- meta_val_col:end_col
  quadrat_names <- raw_data[org_row_idx, quadrat_cols] %>% unlist() %>% as.character() %>% str_trim()
  
  valid_quad_indices <- which(!is.na(quadrat_names) & quadrat_names != "" & quadrat_names != "NA")
  if (length(valid_quad_indices) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  quadrat_cols <- quadrat_cols[valid_quad_indices]
  quadrat_names <- quadrat_names[valid_quad_indices]
  
  # Extract species rows from (org_row_idx + 1) up to row 54
  species_rows <- (org_row_idx + 1):max_row_limit
  species_names <- raw_data[species_rows, meta_label_col][[1]] %>% as.character() %>% str_trim()
  
  valid_spec_indices <- which(!is.na(species_names) & species_names != "" & species_names != "NA" & !str_detect(str_to_upper(species_names), "TOTALS"))
  if (length(valid_spec_indices) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  species_rows <- species_rows[valid_spec_indices]
  species_names <- species_names[valid_spec_indices]
  
  # Build species count matrix for this block
  counts_mat <- raw_data[species_rows, quadrat_cols]
  colnames(counts_mat) <- quadrat_names
  counts_mat$Organism <- species_names
  
  # Reshape long format to wide quadrat sample table
  long_counts <- counts_mat %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -Organism, 
      names_to = "Quadrat_Sample", 
      values_to = "Count"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Count = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Count)), Count = ifelse(is.na(Count), 0, Count)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Organism, values_from = Count, values_fn = max, values_fill = 0)
  
  bind_cols(meta_df, long_counts)
}

# 4. Parse all blocks and stack into a single unified dataframe
combined_dataset_2019 <- map_dfr(block_ranges, ~ parse_survey_block_2019(.x[1], .x[2]))

# 5. Order metadata columns and alphabetically sort all species columns
metadata_cols <- c(
  "Date", "Start Time", "Stop Time", "Number of Transect Lines",
  "Length of Transect Lines", "Point Spacing", "Number of Quadrats per transect",
  "Location", "latitude", "longitude", "School", "Quadrat_Sample"
)

species_cols <- setdiff(names(combined_dataset_2019), metadata_cols)

combined_dataset_2019 <- combined_dataset_2019 %>%
  select(all_of(metadata_cols), sort(species_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(species_cols), ~ replace_na(as.numeric(.), 0)))

# 6. Save the consolidated spreadsheet to CSV
write_csv(combined_dataset_2019, "clean_opihi_2019_ai.csv")
```

Some notes - most of the data looks good here but the Location is not filled in for some of the field trips because the columns were off by 1, I may manually change that myself and re run it.

```{r}
#ai-generated code


# 1. Read raw CSV dataset
raw_data <- read_csv("Data/opihi_2019_ai.csv", col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE)

# 2. Identify all survey block starting column indices (where row 1 == "Date")
block_start_cols <- which(raw_data[1, ] == "Date")

num_cols <- ncol(raw_data)
block_ranges <- map2(
  block_start_cols,
  c(block_start_cols[-1] - 1, num_cols),
  ~ c(.x, .y)
)

# 3. Block parser function that strictly caps row reading at row 54
parse_survey_block_2019 <- function(start_col, end_col) {
  meta_label_col <- start_col
  meta_val_col   <- start_col + 1
  
  # --- Extract Metadata (Rows 1 to 11) ---
  meta_df <- tibble(
    key = raw_data[1:11, meta_label_col][[1]] %>% as.character() %>% str_trim(),
    val = raw_data[1:11, meta_val_col][[1]]
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(key), key != "", key != "NA") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = key, values_from = val, values_fn = first)
  
  # Ensure location value is captured if offset by a column
  if (!"Location" %in% names(meta_df) || is.na(meta_df$Location)) {
    loc_val <- raw_data[8, meta_val_col + 1][[1]]
    if (!is.na(loc_val) && str_trim(loc_val) != "") {
      meta_df$Location <- as.character(loc_val)
    }
  }
  
  standard_meta <- c(
    "Date", "Start Time", "Stop Time", "Number of Transect Lines",
    "Length of Transect Lines", "Point Spacing", "Number of Quadrats per transect",
    "Location", "latitude", "longitude", "School"
  )
  for (m in standard_meta) {
    if (!m %in% names(meta_df)) meta_df[[m]] <- NA_character_
  }
  
  # Locate 'Organisms' header row (typically row 13)
  org_row_idx <- which(raw_data[12:20, meta_label_col][[1]] == "Organisms") + 11
  if (length(org_row_idx) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # --- Cap reading strictly to Row 54 ---
  max_row_limit <- min(nrow(raw_data), 54)
  
  # Extract quadrat header names (e.g. T-1 Q-1 at point 0.00)
  quadrat_cols <- meta_val_col:end_col
  quadrat_names <- raw_data[org_row_idx, quadrat_cols] %>% unlist() %>% as.character() %>% str_trim()
  
  valid_quad_indices <- which(!is.na(quadrat_names) & quadrat_names != "" & quadrat_names != "NA")
  if (length(valid_quad_indices) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  quadrat_cols <- quadrat_cols[valid_quad_indices]
  quadrat_names <- quadrat_names[valid_quad_indices]
  
  # Extract individual quadrat species rows from (org_row_idx + 1) up to row 54
  species_rows <- (org_row_idx + 1):max_row_limit
  species_names <- raw_data[species_rows, meta_label_col][[1]] %>% as.character() %>% str_trim()
  
  valid_spec_indices <- which(
    !is.na(species_names) & 
      species_names != "" & 
      species_names != "NA" & 
      !str_detect(str_to_upper(species_names), "TOTALS")
  )
  if (length(valid_spec_indices) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  species_rows <- species_rows[valid_spec_indices]
  species_names <- species_names[valid_spec_indices]
  
  # Build count matrix for individual quadrats
  counts_mat <- raw_data[species_rows, quadrat_cols]
  colnames(counts_mat) <- quadrat_names
  counts_mat$Organism <- species_names
  
  # Reshape long format to wide quadrat sample table
  long_counts <- counts_mat %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -Organism, 
      names_to = "Quadrat_Sample", 
      values_to = "Count"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Count = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Count)), Count = ifelse(is.na(Count), 0, Count)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Organism, values_from = Count, values_fn = max, values_fill = 0)
  
  bind_cols(meta_df, long_counts)
}

# 4. Process all blocks into a single combined dataframe
combined_dataset_2019_2 <- map_dfr(block_ranges, ~ parse_survey_block_2019(.x[1], .x[2]))

# 5. Arrange metadata columns first, followed by alphabetically sorted species columns
metadata_cols <- c(
  "Date", "Start Time", "Stop Time", "Number of Transect Lines",
  "Length of Transect Lines", "Point Spacing", "Number of Quadrats per transect",
  "Location", "latitude", "longitude", "School", "Quadrat_Sample"
)

species_cols <- setdiff(names(combined_dataset_2019_2), metadata_cols)

combined_dataset_2019_2 <- combined_dataset_2019_2 %>%
  select(all_of(metadata_cols), sort(species_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(species_cols), ~ replace_na(as.numeric(.), 0)))

# 6. Save consolidated CSV file
write_csv(combined_dataset_2019_2, "clean_opihi_2019_ai.csv")
```

Output looks pretty good now!
